title: Native model picker protocol
responsibility: Normalizes protocol objects and identifies the provider for supported native picker model selections.

inputs.name: nativePickerProtocol.value
inputs.description: Unknown protocol value, returned as is only when it is a non-null, non-array object; the function never reads or validates its keys. Every other value, including null, undefined, primitives, arrays and functions, is replaced by a new empty object.

inputs.name: pickerProvider.model
inputs.description: Selected model value that determines the provider: exactly 'claude-opus-5-5' maps to 'harness-claude', and any other string not beginning with 'claude-' maps to 'openai'. Nonstring values and other strings beginning with 'claude-' are rejected by throwing an Error.

outputs.name: nativePickerProtocol
outputs.description: The same object reference that was passed in, cast to PickerData without copying, when that input is a non-null, non-array object. For any other input, a new empty object is returned on each call.

outputs.name: pickerProvider
outputs.description: Provider identifier for the selected model: 'harness-claude' for exactly 'claude-opus-5-5', and 'openai' for any other string not beginning with 'claude-'. The function never returns any other string and throws instead for the remaining inputs.

outputs.name: nativeOpusModel
outputs.description: Constant catalog entry for Claude Opus 5.5 through Harness, with isDefault set to false, xhigh as its only supported reasoning effort, and text and image as input modalities. Its description states that native hosted web search is unavailable in this experiment, and the functions in this module never read it.

examples.description: Claude Code subscription through the local Harness gateway. Native hosted web search is unavailable in this experiment.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown with the message 'Unsupported model selection' by pickerProvider when the model is not a string or is a string beginning with 'claude-' other than exactly 'claude-opus-5-5'. nativePickerProtocol never throws.
